note: Triennial election of the rural district council (29 divisions), 1955: contests in Ballymoyer and Mullaghbane, polled 2 June 1955; no party labels printed for the unopposed members. Returned unopposed. The outgoing member, Patrick McArdle, withdrew his nomination, averting a contest. Thomas Clarke: no party label printed in 1955. At other elections he stood as Anti-Partitionist (Moybane, 2 June 1949, printed 'Anti-Partitionist': Newry Telegraph, 21 May 1949, p. 3 ("Newry No. 2 (Co. Armagh) Rural District Council (election nominations)"); Frontier Sentinel, 21 May 1949, p. 3 ("Newry and Kilkeel Rural Councils' Nominations")) and as Nationalist (Crossmaglen, 5 June 1958, printed 'N.': Newry Telegraph, 7 June 1958, p. 4 ("Rural Council Elections"); Newry Telegraph, 24 May 1958, p. 1 ("The Council Elections: Newry No. 2 (Co. Armagh) Rural District Council (nominations)"); Newry Reporter, 12 June 1958, p. 2 ("The Rural Council Elections: most members retained seats", results with votes cast and spoilt)).
